name: MultiModal-Planning-Benchmark
description: Benchmark that measures an agent's ability to generate and ground multi-step plans from multimodal inputs (e.g., images plus instructions). It evaluates planning quality, instruction-following and the correctness of multi-step action sequences in embodied or simulated settings.
reputation: A specialized, recent benchmark targeted at multimodal planning and embodied agents with limited but growing use in research on vision-and-language planning.
